description: This file defines a JavaScript/TypeScript class 'JavaLanguageGenerator' that generates Java code for Playwright test scripts, supporting different modes like 'library' and 'junit'. It includes methods for generating actions, headers, footers, and formatting options, and references external modules for formatting and utilities.

classes.name: JavaLanguageGenerator
classes.description: A class that generates Java code snippets for Playwright actions, supporting 'library' and 'junit' modes, with methods for generating action code, headers, footers, and formatting options.

methods.name: generateAction
methods.description: Generates Java code for a given Playwright action based on the context and mode.

methods.name: _generateActionCall
methods.description: Creates Java code for specific actions like click, navigate, check, etc.

methods.name: generateHeader
methods.description: Generates the Java code header for the test script, including imports and setup.

methods.name: generateFooter
methods.description: Generates the footer code, including storage state saving.
